comparison: Compared with control rhbi-v9 (readout-264443fda23520da74a1fe0a), rhbi-v10 preserved 15/16 Tier 1 task grades bit-for-bit or with matching pass margins, while over-amplified 96th-quantile valley tail-spill gain (1.8) delayed thermal cooling on model_ae_gan_multimodal from step 550 (passing_suffix=14/5 in rhbi-v9) to step 1050 (passing_suffix=4/5), blocking Tier 2 progression before vector_anisotropic could be measured.
conclusion: inconclusive_tier1_blocked: rhbi-v10 passed 15/16 executed Tier 1 tasks (including ring16_acquisition, precision_gaussian_fp32/mxfp8/nvfp4, and clockfree_audit_measurement_v1), and model_ae_gan_multimodal passed all 8 terminal metric bounds at step 1200 (precision=0.9431 >= 0.90, component_center_rms_sigma=0.9560 <= 1.0) but missed the 5-checkpoint terminal stability suffix by 1 step (passing_suffix=4/5, component_center_rms_sigma=1.0017 at step 1000) because rhbi_tail_spill_gain=1.8 held thermal scale s_t warm too long against uncooled autoencoder reconstruction gradients.
